West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited and Others”. 2. The Review Petitioner has made the following prayers in the instant Review Petition: - _(a) Admit the Petition._ - _(b) Review Para Nos. 37, 53 and 55 of the Order dated 19.7.2025 in Petition No. 45/TT/2023 to the extent sought in the present Review Petition._ - _(c) Condone the time overrun of 798 days (for delay in forest clearance), 242 Days (for delay due to Covid-19 Pandemic) and 323 Days (due to COVID-19 restrictions imposed by the Govt of Bhutan);_ - _(d) Allow the capitalization of IDC and IEDC for the said period and grant consequential tariff._ - (e) _Pass such further or other order(s) that this Commission may deem fit and proper.”_ 3. During the hearing of the matter on 29.6.2026, the learned counsel for the Review Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present Review Petition with liberty to seek the reliefs sought herein during the truing-up of the tariff for the 2019-24 period. 4. The learned counsel for Respondent Nos. 2, 7 and 8, i.e. Bihar State Power (Holding) Company Limited (BSPHCL), North Bihar Power Distribution Company Limited (NBPDCL) Page **3** of **4** Order in Review Petition No. 23/RP/2025 in Petition No. 45/TT/2023 and South Bihar Power Distribution Company Limited (SBPDCL), respectively, while opposing the grant of a specific liberty to the Review Petitioner, submitted that the Review Petitioner may be allowed to withdraw this Review Petition subject to it being permitted to seek the reliefs claimed herein at the time of truing-up in accordance with law. 5. Considering the submissions of the learned counsels for the parties, the Review Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Review Petition, with liberty to seek the reliefs sought in this Review Petition in the true-up Petition, which shall be considered strictly in accordance with law. 6. Accordingly, Review Petition No. 23/RP/2025 in Petition No. 45/TT/2023 is disposed of as withdrawn. **sd/sd/sd/(Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.)
